# GrowDev

> GrowDev is a software company based in Tunisia. It builds Odoo ERP systems, WordPress websites, PrestaShop online shops, web and mobile applications and automation for businesses in Tunisia, across Africa and worldwide, in French, Arabic and English.

## Key facts

- Name: GrowDev (slogan: "Your growth, our code.")
- Based in: Tunisia
- Activity: Software development: Odoo ERP, web, mobile, automation
- Coverage: Tunisia first, then Africa and worldwide, remotely
- Languages: French, Arabic, English
- Quotes: In DT for Tunisia, in € or $ internationally
- Founder: Aziz Chaibi, full-stack developer specialised in odoo
- Contact: contact@growdev.tn

- [GrowDev en français](https://growdev.tn/): GrowDev, société de développement en Tunisie : ERP Odoo, sites web, boutiques en ligne, applications mobiles. Pour la Tunisie, l’Afrique et le monde.
- [GrowDev بالعربية](https://growdev.tn/ar/): GrowDev شركة تطوير برمجيات في تونس: نظام Odoo ERP ومواقع الويب والمتاجر الإلكترونية وتطبيقات الجوال للمؤسسات في تونس وإفريقيا والعالم.
- [GrowDev in English](https://growdev.tn/en/): GrowDev is a software company in Tunisia: Odoo ERP, websites, online shops and mobile apps for businesses in Tunisia, Africa and worldwide.

## Services

- [Odoo ERP](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-odoo): Run your whole business in a single tool: sales, purchasing, stock, invoicing, production.
- [Digital transformation](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-digital): We spot what wastes your time, then simplify it, step by step.
- [Web development](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-web): Custom websites and web applications, fast and secure.
- [WordPress websites](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-wp): A site you can edit yourself, without depending on anyone.
- [PrestaShop store](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-shop): Sell online with a clear shop, from catalogue to payment.
- [Mobile apps](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-mobile): An Android and iOS app connected to your data.
- [Automation](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-auto): No more copy-paste: your repetitive tasks run on their own.

## Which of these sounds like you?

- [One management tool (Odoo)](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-odoo): I retype the same information in several files and programs. Sales, purchasing, stock and invoicing in one place. Type it once and everything is up to date.
- [Automation](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-auto): I spend my days copy-pasting, sending the same emails and rebuilding the same reports. Your tools talk to each other and repetitive tasks run on their own.
- [An online shop (PrestaShop)](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-shop): I want to sell my products online. Catalogue, cart, online payment and delivery in one clear shop.
- [A WordPress website](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-wp): I want a website that looks like me and that I can edit myself. A polished site where you change texts and photos without calling anyone.
- [A custom web or mobile app](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-web): No off-the-shelf software fits my line of work: I need an app of my own. A tool built around the way you work, on computer and phone, connected to your data.
- [Taking stock together](https://growdev.tn/en/#svc-digital): I feel I am losing time, but I don’t know where to start. We review your tools and habits, then suggest a simple step-by-step plan.

## Developer profile

- At GrowDev you talk to the person who writes the code: Aziz Chaibi, a full-stack developer specialised in Odoo. Here are our tools and the way we work, for recruiters and technical teams.
- How we work: Remote, in French, Arabic or English. A written scope before any code: goals, schedule, deliverables. Short deliveries that you approve step by step. Clean, documented code, versioned with Git. Backups and security in place before go-live.
- Odoo and business management: Custom modules, links with other tools, data migration, hosting and updates.
- Web and e-commerce: Websites, shops and web apps in three languages, with right-to-left Arabic.
- Mobile: Android and iOS apps from a single codebase, connected to your API or your ERP.
- Servers and deployment: Deployment, backups, security and version-controlled code.
- See this website’s source code: https://github.com/growdev-tn/growdev-tn.github.io

## FAQ

- [What is Odoo and what does it do for my business?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Odoo is a modular business management software (ERP).
- [Is Odoo a good fit for a Tunisian small or medium business?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Yes, as soon as your sales, stock or invoicing are spread across separate files and tools.
- [How much does an Odoo project, a website or an app cost?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): The price depends on the scope: number of modules, volume of data to migrate, custom development and training.
- [How long does it take to set up Odoo?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): It depends on the number of modules.
- [Do you work with companies outside Tunisia?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Yes.
- [Can my website or app be in Arabic, French and English?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Yes.
- [WordPress, PrestaShop or a custom app: which one should I choose?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): WordPress suits showcase sites and blogs that you edit yourself.
- [What happens after the launch?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): We train your team, set up backups and security, then keep following up: fixes, updates and new features, at the pace of your business.
- [I know nothing about IT: can I still trust you with my project?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Yes.
- [Do you take on freelance development work for recruiters, agencies or technical teams?](https://growdev.tn/en/#faq): Yes.
